'''Lokaibus''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] living during the [[Galactic War]], who ran a series of beast combat rings called the [[Slavering Arenas]]. In [[3637 BBY]] a shipment of beast delivered to the arenas was hijacked by the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] above [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and Lokaibus's servant [[Tibor (Rishi)|Tibor]] was tasked with retrieving them.
